title: E2E success from main menu - non-AmEx (Visa) with OTP verify, front/back CVV, manual Finish
description: Covers Sc0003 → Sc0004 → Sc0006 generateOtp → Sc0005 verifyOtp → Sc0012 front → Sc0014 back CVV → Sc0016 Finish (PUT). Validates PCI masking, OTT use, client-side decryption, timer continuity, cache and navigation.
testDescription: Authenticated retail customer views Visa card details from main menu, completes OTP, decrypts data from external processor, views front then back CVV, and finishes before timer expiry.
prerequisites: Authenticated retail customer with active current account, at least one eligible card with brandCode=2 Visa and cardSuffix 1445; customer has verified mobile phone 052-6****53; test environment hooked to sandbox external processor with deterministic OTT and card payload; app build with RTL Hebrew resources and English fallback; logging set to PCI DSS scrub mode.
stepsToPerform:
1. Launch web app and log in as retail customer; confirm session is established.
2. From main menu/cards world, click 'View card details' to enter Sc0003 (card list).
3. Intercept GET card-channel/web-order/card-account/cards/details with headers partyAccounts.bankNumber=12, partyAccounts.branchNumber=345, partyAccounts.accountNumber=678901 and query activityTypeCode=902; stub 200 response with two cards including Visa brandCode=2 cardVendorProductId=VISA-GOLD cardSuffix=1445; verify last4 only present; verify text IDs 21000–21004 populate.
4. Verify client caches all fields for each card on Sc0003 (cardSuffix, brandCode, cardVendorProductId, names) and that Home and Continue buttons render; select Visa ending 1445 and click Continue to reach Sc0004.
5. On Sc0004 verify texts 21005–21008, images load from client asset store, and Back button would return to Sc0003 with prior selection retained; click 'View card details'.
6. Intercept POST card-channel/web-order/restore-card-information/orders (generateOtp) with body activityTypeCode=902, cardIssuingSpCode, creditCardSerialId, cardIdServiceProvider, cardSuffix=1445, birthDate (masked in logs), brandCode=2, smsByVoice=false; return 200 with orderId=ORD-123, masked phone; assert orderId cached.
7. On Sc0005 verify masked phone number is shown via text 21050; confirm numeric-only 6-cell input, focus order, and that copy/paste is restricted to digits; enter a valid 6-digit OTP 470221 and click Continue.
8. Intercept POST .../verify-otp with body activityTypeCode=902, cardIssuingSpCode, otpPassword=470221, orderId=ORD-123; return 200 with brandCode=2, OTT=ott-token-xyz, encryptionKey=encKey-abc; assert orderId unchanged across calls.
9. Client calls external processor PartnerAuthentication.Api/api/GetEncryptedCardData/getEncryptedCardData with header authorization=ott-token-xyz; return encrypted payload decryptable only with encryptionKey=encKey-abc; client decrypts to PAN 4111111111111111, expiry 04/25, cvv 123; assert decryption done client-side, no logs of plaintext.
10. Show Sc0012 front card view: verify brand image mapping picks Visa, card number 16 digits spaced, expiry shows, label 'Copy details' (21105), timer banner (21102, 21103) starts at 90; verify 'View CVV' and 'Finish' buttons present; click 'View CVV'.
11. On Sc0014 back side, verify timer continues (no reset) e.g., ~85s remaining; show CVV=123, advisory text 21110, 'Back to card details' and 'Finish' shown; click 'Back to card details'.
12. Back on Sc0012 verify remaining seconds did not reset; test clipboard: click 'Copy details' and confirm clipboard contains PAN and expiry only, no CVV; confirm tooltip does not expose sensitive data persistently.
13. Click 'Finish'; intercept PUT card-channel/web-order/restore-card-information/ORD-123 with header partyAccounts.bankNumber,branchNumber,accountNumber and body activityTypeCode=902; return 200.
14. Show Sc0016 end screen: assert texts 21150–21152 with cardSuffix 1445, and buttons 'More actions on card' and 'Home' navigate correctly; select Home and verify session returns to cards world.
15. Security cleanup: attempt to reuse the same OTT to call processor again should fail (401/expired); verify client clears OTT, encryptionKey, and decrypted PAN/CVV from memory/cache; verify no secrets in network logs.
expectedResult: Customer successfully views Visa card details within 90 seconds, timer persists across front/back views, and manual Finish issues PUT finalize with 200. OTT and encryptionKey used once and cleared, PCI masking enforced (only last4 pre-view, masked phone, no CVV in clipboard), images resolve by brand mapping, and navigation/state/cache behave as specified.

title: E2E AmEx flow from post-order lobby with auto-finish on timer expiry
description: Covers Sc0002/Sc0003 entry with creditCardSerialId, Sc0004, OTP generate/verify, Sc0013 front (PAN+expiry+CVV already visible), Sc0014 back CVV, timer continuity and auto-finalization (PUT) when timer hits zero.
testDescription: Customer lands from order lobby, selects newly issued AmEx, completes OTP, views card details, navigates front/back until timer expires to auto-finish.
prerequisites: Authenticated user just completed card order; AmEx card available with brandCode=3, cardSuffix 8850; lobby passes creditCardSerialId=cardIdHapoalim; verified mobile; processor sandbox supports AmEx dual-CVV guidance; timer observable hooks enabled.
stepsToPerform:
1. From post-order 'lobby actions', click 'View card details' to trigger Sc0002/Sc0003 flow with creditCardSerialId param.
2. Intercept GET .../cards/details?activityTypeCode=902&creditCardSerialId=cardIdHapoalim; return 200 with a single AmEx card brandCode=3 cardSuffix=8850; verify screen shows Sc0004 immediately per spec or Sc0003 minimal list then Sc0004; ensure text IDs 21005–21008 present.
3. Click 'View card details' to POST generateOtp with body including brandCode=3 and smsByVoice=false; return 200 with orderId=ORD-AMEX-1, phone masked.
4. On Sc0005 enter valid 6-digit OTP and click Continue; verify POST verify-otp with same orderId returns 200 containing OTT and encryptionKey and brandCode=3.
5. Client calls processor GetEncryptedCardData with authorization OTT and decrypts using encryptionKey; payload contains PAN length 15, expiry MM/YY, CVV front 4 digits for AmEx where applicable; assert decryption success.
6. Render Sc0013 front card: verify brand image is AmEx, texts 21100–21106 appear, cvvTitle and AmEx info text 21108 present; confirm presence of 'View back CVV' button.
7. Start timer at 90s; navigate to Sc0014 via 'View back CVV' and confirm timer continues (does not reset) with decreased seconds; note remaining seconds.

10. Verify app automatically navigates to Sc0015/Sc0016 end screen with texts 21150–21152 showing cardSuffix 8850; ensure 'More actions on card' returns customer to post-order lobby and orderId/OTT/encryptionKey caches cleared.
11. Attempt browser back to Sc0013; verify guarded by state gating and shows a fresh Sc0004 requiring OTP again.

title: Zero-state gating and entry sources mapping (Sc0001 and Sc0002)
description: Validates decision-table mapping of service HTTP codes to zero-state screens, CTAs and navigation from both entry sources.
testDescription: From main menu, handle 204 and 203/ID=32 as Sc0001; from post-order lobby handle 203/ID=31 as Sc0002 with Try Again behavior flowing to pre-view on subsequent success.
prerequisites: Authenticated user; service stubs able to return 204, 203/ID=32, 203/ID=31 and later 200; feature flags for ‘Order a new card’ CTA active.
stepsToPerform:
1. From main menu, click 'View card details' to call GET cards/details with activityTypeCode=902 and proper headers.
2. Stub response HttpStatusCode=204; verify UI shows Sc0001 zero-state with texts explaining no cards found (per items 3–5) and buttons 'Order a new card' and 'Home'; validate RTL and text IDs presence.
3. Click 'Order a new card' and assert navigation to new card order process; return to main menu.
4. Initiate the flow again; stub GET response with HttpStatusCode=203 and error ID=32; verify Sc0001 (not Sc0002) is shown as per doc note; assert same texts and CTAs; click 'Home' and confirm return to cards world.
5. From post-order lobby, click 'View card details' to call GET cards/details with activityTypeCode=902 and creditCardSerialId=cardIdHapoalim.
6. Stub response HttpStatusCode=203 with error ID=31; verify Sc0002 zero-state texts appear including guidance and the 'Try again' button.
7. Click 'Try again'; repeat GET with same headers and query; stub 200 with one card entry; verify transition proceeds to Sc0004 pre-view (no OTP yet); texts 21005–21008 appear.
8. Press Back on Sc0004; verify return to caller screen preserves account context and no leaked card cache when re-entering other accounts.
9. Verify that activityTypeCode=902 is always present; remove it in a negative attempt and ensure 400/blocked state is shown with safe error (no leakage).
expectedResult: Main menu returns 204 or 203/ID=32 map to Sc0001; post-order 203/ID=31 maps to Sc0002. CTAs navigate correctly; 'Try again' re-calls API and proceeds on 200; required headers and activityTypeCode enforced.

title: OTP/SCA negative, boundary and throttling with recovery
description: Covers input validation on OTP, wrong/expired code handling, resend via SMS/Voice, throttling lockouts and recovery, missing mobile popup.
testDescription: From Sc0004 pre-view, exercise OTP validations and error pathways Sc0007, Sc0008, Sc0009, Sc0010, Sc0011; verify state resets and orderId continuity rules.
prerequisites: User has at least one eligible non-AmEx card; ability to stub OTP endpoints with specific 203 error IDs; UI configured to show inline validation per text IDs 21055–21056.
stepsToPerform:
1. Start from Sc0003 → Sc0004 for a card; click 'View card details' to POST generateOtp; return 200 with orderId=ORD-NEG and masked phone; ensure smsByVoice=false.
2. On Sc0005, test boundary inputs: enter fewer than 6 digits (e.g., 12345) → Continue disabled; enter 7 digits via paste → field trims/refuses extra; type letters or whitespace → rejected; enter '001234' to verify leading zeros allowed.
3. Submit a wrong 6-digit code; stub verify-otp to 203 ID=31; assert Sc0007 inline error 21055 in red, input clears, error disappears on new typing; orderId persists.
4. Press 'Send code again by SMS'; verify POST resendOtp to .../restore-card-information/ORD-NEG/resend with smsByVoice=false; success 200 shows Sc0006 text 21051; submit another wrong code until server returns 203 ID=32 for verify attempts; assert popup Sc0011 shows texts 21057–21058 and process exits to caller on close.
5. Wait the required few minutes (simulate clock jump) then restart flow; ensure a new generateOtp returns new orderId=ORD-NEG-2 and previous orderId rejected by verify-otp.
6. Trigger expired code path: enter a previously sent OTP after server TTL; stub verify-otp 203 ID=33; assert Sc0008 shows text 21056 in red, input disabled; user must restart; verify Back returns to Sc0004 safely.
7. Test voice resend throttling: start again (orderId=ORD-VOICE), press 'Send voice code'; verify resendOtp called with smsByVoice=true; repeat sending until service returns 203 ID=32 for send attempts; assert popup Sc0010 shows 10-minute wait message and exits flow; attempt re-entry before wait shows same block.
8. Test missing mobile number: start again and stub generateOtp 203 ID=31; assert popup Sc0009 with guidance to update mobile; closing returns to caller; ensure no orderId issued.
9. Recovery: after specified waits elapse (simulate), start fresh and complete a successful OTP to ensure state clears and you can proceed to details; confirm new orderId is used end-to-end.
expectedResult: OTP UI enforces 6-digit numeric entry with leading zeros allowed; wrong code shows inline error and clears input; verify throttling and resend throttling popups with correct texts and wait durations; expired code disables input until restart; voice vs SMS flags are honored; missing phone results in immediate popup and exit; after waits, flow can restart with a new orderId.

title: External processor and security robustness: OTT expiry, decryption failure, image fallback, multi-tab and finalize idempotency
description: Exercises non-happy paths after OTP success: processor 401, decryption error, missing brand image, multi-tab sessions, finalize idempotency, and clipboard/privacy protections.
testDescription: After a successful verifyOtp, validate that failures and edge conditions are handled safely without exposing PAN/CVV, and that session state is coherent across tabs.
prerequisites: User can complete OTP successfully; processor sandbox configurable to return 401 and malformed payloads; app supports placeholder images; feature allows multiple browser tabs.
stepsToPerform:
1. Complete flow to OTP verify (as in TC-VC-001) obtaining OTT=ott-expire and encryptionKey=encKey-1 with brandCode=1 MasterCard; confirm orderId=ORD-RB.
2. Case A (OTT expired): call processor with authorization=ott-expire; stub 401; assert UI shows safe error (no PAN/CVV), returns to Sc0004 or offers retry, and a new OTP is required; confirm no decrypted data cached.
3. Restart OTP verify to get fresh OTT=ott-baddec and encryptionKey=encKey-2; processor returns encrypted blob that cannot be decrypted with encKey-2; client decryption throws; assert UI blocks display, shows safe error, and never renders Sc0012/13/14; no partial digits shown; logs scrubbed.
4. Restart OTP verify and processor success with brandCode=7 Isracard but intentionally provide missing brand image in client assets; verify fallback placeholder image is displayed with alt text and no crash; PAN and expiry visible; timer starts.
5. Open a second browser tab and paste the current deep-link (if any) while timer is running; ensure sensitive view is not replicated: either requires OTP again or shows timed-out state; only the original tab shows data until timer ends; verify orderId is single-session bound.
6. While timer still >0, hit Finish on original tab twice quickly; intercept PUT finalize for ORD-RB-NEW and return 200 then ignore duplicates; ensure only one success toast and no duplicate finalize calls after the first (idempotency via orderId); after finalize, GetEncryptedCardData with same OTT returns 401.
7. Validate timer does not reset on browser refresh within the allowed time; either returns to safe state requiring OTP again, or resumes with remaining seconds without re-fetching decryption key; confirm chosen behavior matches spec (prefer safe re-auth).
8. Validate clipboard rules: click 'Copy details' and check clipboard contains only PAN and expiry, not CVV; confirm clipboard cleared on route change to Finish.
9. Verify HTTP and headers security: remove or change bankNumber/branchNumber/accountNumber and assert 403 or safe block; verify no cross-account card details can be fetched; confirm activityTypeCode=902 is present on all calls.
expectedResult: Processor 401 and decryption failures are handled without any PAN/CVV exposure; placeholder image used when missing; multi-tab cannot duplicate sensitive view; finalize is idempotent; OTT and keys invalidated after finalize; headers and activity code enforced; clipboard never includes CVV and is cleared.

title: Card selection cache, image fallback, and switch-after-generate invalidates prior orderId
description: Validate Sc0003 cache of card metadata, fallback for missing cardVendorProductId image, and that switching cards after generateOtp cancels the previous orderId to prevent mixed-card leakage.
testDescription: User enters from main menu, views multiple cards, triggers generateOtp for card A, navigates back to list, selects card B, and confirms a new orderId is created while the old orderId is rejected. Ensures cache is keyed by account headers and card images fallback when missing.
prerequisites: Authenticated retail user with two different accounts A and B. Account A has three cards: MasterCard brandCode=1 suffix 1445 (cardVendorProductId=MC-GOLD), Visa brandCode=2 suffix 8850 (cardVendorProductId missing to force fallback), Isracard brandCode=7 suffix 9921 (cardVendorProductId=ISR-STD). Account B has one Visa brandCode=2 suffix 2222. User has verified mobile 052-6****53.
stepsToPerform:
1. From main menu/cards world, click 'View card details' to reach Sc0003. Intercept GET card-channel/web-order/card-account/cards/details with headers for Account A and query activityTypeCode=902; return 200 with three cards as per prerequisites and text IDs 21000–21004.
2. Verify Sc0003 lists all three cards with only last 4 digits shown, owner name from partyFirstName+partyLastName, and images by cardVendorProductId; confirm Visa (8850) shows placeholder image due to missing cardVendorProductId with accessible alt text.
3. Validate that client caches all card objects (brandCode, cardVendorProductId, cardSuffix, cardIssuingSpCode, creditCardSerialId, cardIdServiceProvider) for back navigation; select MasterCard 1445 and click Continue to Sc0004.
4. On Sc0004 verify texts 21005–21008 and that Back will return to Sc0003 with MasterCard 1445 pre-selected; click 'View card details' to POST generateOtp.
5. Intercept POST generateOtp returning 200 with orderId=ORD-CACHE-1, smsByVoice=false, masked phone 052-6****53; ensure orderId cached with selected card fingerprint (cardIdServiceProvider+cardSuffix+brandCode).
6. At Sc0005 OTP screen, click Back → Sc0004, then Back again → Sc0003; verify cache restores list state and MasterCard remains selected without exposing PAN or phone beyond masking.
7. Change selection to Visa 8850 and click Continue to Sc0004; press 'View card details' to POST generateOtp again; return 200 with orderId=ORD-CACHE-2; assert UI displays resend controls tied to ORD-CACHE-2.
8. Negative check: in a dev tool, attempt to POST verify-otp using the old orderId=ORD-CACHE-1 with any 6-digit code; stub service to return 400 or 203 ID=33 for stale/expired order; ensure UI handles response as a blocked state (returns to Sc0004 or shows Sc0008 if 203/33), and the active flow remains on ORD-CACHE-2 only.
9. Proceed on Sc0005 for ORD-CACHE-2 and confirm masked phone persists; do not complete verify to avoid PAN exposure; navigate Back to Sc0004 and then Home to exit; re-enter from main menu and confirm new GET list call and that previous selection is cleared.
10. Switch to Account B by changing headers (bankNumber, branchNumber, accountNumber) and re-enter Sc0003; verify only Visa 2222 appears and that the previous Account A cache is not visible; returning to Account A shows its cached list again.
expectedResult: Selecting a different card after generateOtp issues a new orderId; the previous orderId cannot be used and is safely rejected. Sc0003 card metadata is cached per account scope, Back preserves selection, Home clears transient state, and no mixed-card leakage occurs. Missing product image in Sc0003 falls back to placeholder with alt text.

title: Timer robustness with backgrounding, clock skew, and finalize retry on network failure
description: Validate 90-second timer continuity across foreground/background, resilience to device clock changes, and reliable finalize behavior with retry when PUT fails.
testDescription: After OTP success for a non-AmEx card, user backgrounds the app, manipulates system clock forward/back, and encounters a finalize PUT timeout. App must keep a monotonic 90s window, auto-finalize exactly once, and retry finalize safely.
prerequisites: Authenticated user with MasterCard brandCode=1. Environment can simulate browser tab backgrounding and intercept PUT finalize to force one timeout then success. Processor sandbox returns valid encrypted payload.
stepsToPerform:
1. Complete flow to OTP verify for MasterCard and receive OTT=ott-time, encryptionKey=encKey-time; call external processor and decrypt to PAN 5454 5454 5454 5454, expiry 05/27; render Sc0012; start timer at 90.
2. Note remaining seconds (e.g., ~88). Without leaving Sc0012, background the tab/app for 30 seconds via dev tools; resume and verify timer now shows about 58–60 seconds, not reset.
3. Navigate to Sc0014 'View CVV'; confirm timer continues without reset and shows same or slightly reduced remaining seconds; navigate back to Sc0012 and ensure continuity remains.
4. Change system clock forward by +2 minutes; observe that timer immediately reaches zero; assert UI triggers auto PUT finalize to card-channel/web-order/restore-card-information/{order-id} with activityTypeCode=902.
5. Simulate finalize network timeout on first attempt (e.g., 504 or network error). App shows non-sensitive transient error state (no PAN/CVV re-render), keeps details hidden, and retries finalize once more after a short delay.
6. Return 200 on the second PUT finalize; verify only a single success is recorded and Sc0016 end screen shows texts 21150–21152 with correct cardSuffix; OTT and encryptionKey are cleared from memory.
7. Press browser Back; the app should not return to Sc0012/14. If it does, ensure sensitive values are not present and user must re-run OTP.
8. Attempt to change device clock backwards by -5 minutes before auto-finalize in a new run; confirm the timer does not increase or restart and continues counting down based on monotonic time source until zero.
9. Security check: ensure no sensitive data remains in DOM after finalize or during retry, and that no duplicate PUT calls are sent after success.
expectedResult: Timer remains consistent across backgrounding and clock skew, never resets across Sc0012/Sc0014, and auto-finalizes on expiry. If finalize fails temporarily, the app retries and completes once; no PAN/CVV persists post-finalize and back navigation cannot re-expose details.

title: Processor payload completeness checks: missing expiry or CVV fields block rendering
description: Validate that incomplete decrypted payloads from the external processor (missing expiry or CVV fields) never render partial details and that the user is safely returned to pre-view to restart.
testDescription: Simulate processor responses missing mandatory fields and confirm safe error handling with no PAN/CVV exposure and secret purge.
prerequisites: Authenticated user with two cards: Visa brandCode=2 suffix 1445 and AmEx brandCode=3 suffix 8850. Processor sandbox can omit fields selectively.
stepsToPerform:
1. Start with Visa 1445: Sc0003 select Visa → Sc0004 → generateOtp returns 200 orderId=ORD-MISS-1 → Sc0005 enter valid OTP; verify-otp 200 with brandCode=2, OTT=ott-miss-visa, encryptionKey=encKey-miss-visa.
2. Call processor with authorization=ott-miss-visa and return an encrypted blob that decrypts to PAN 4111111111111445 but omits expiry (null or empty). Do not provide CVV in payload as it is shown only on Sc0014 later.
3. Client attempts to render Sc0012; assert the app detects missing expiry and blocks rendering with a safe error (no digits shown), returns to Sc0004, and purges OTT/encryptionKey from memory.
4. Attempt to reuse the same OTT via a manual processor call; expect 401; UI remains on Sc0004 requiring restart.
5. Now test AmEx 8850: Sc0003 select AmEx → Sc0004 → generateOtp returns 200 orderId=ORD-MISS-2 → verify-otp 200 with brandCode=3, OTT=ott-miss-amex, encryptionKey=encKey-miss-amex.
6. Processor returns payload with PAN 378282246310005 and expiry 12/26 but omits CVV fields; client must not render Sc0013 with front CVV; instead show safe error and return to Sc0004; purge secrets.
7. Restart AmEx flow and provide complete payload; render Sc0013 and confirm AmEx info 21108 appears; navigate to Sc0014 and verify CVV visible; timer runs.
8. Click Finish; intercept PUT finalize for ORD-MISS-3 (new orderId after restart) returns 200; show Sc0016 with texts 21150–21152 for suffix 8850.
9. Verify that in both missing-field cases, no PAN/CVV appears in DOM or telemetry, and the clipboard remains unaffected (no copy control available because details never rendered).
expectedResult: Any missing required field (expiry for non-AmEx details screen, CVV for AmEx front) prevents rendering. The app shows a safe error, purges OTT/encryptionKey, requires restart, and does not expose any digits.
entryPath: Main menu → card list → pre-view → OTP → details
bodyParams: generateOtp includes activityTypeCode=902, card metadata; verify-otp includes otpPassword, orderId; finalize includes activityTypeCode=902
responseCode: 200 for OTP calls, 200 for processor when payload missing mandatory fields (client-side block), 401 on OTT reuse, 200 for finalize
errorId: none from processor; safe client error on UI
securityControlsValidated: Payload completeness validation, secrets purge on error, OTT single-use, no sensitive render on incomplete data
maskingRules: Only last4 before details; no PAN/CVV rendered on error; masked phone on OTP
cacheUsage: Decrypted data discarded immediately on validation failure; no caching to storage
navigationTarget: Return to Sc0004 on error; Sc0016 on successful restart flow
accessibilityChecks: Error banner role=alert with clear guidance; focus returns to actionable control on Sc0004
assumptionNotes: ASSUMPTION: Expiry and CVV are mandatory for rendering; client validates presence before showing any digits
